recentItems.title: Death of Fiona the hippo draws global response
recentItems.description:
Fiona, the beloved hippopotamus who captured hearts around the world after her premature birth at the Cincinnati Zoo, has died following a medical emergency.

The Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden announced the news in an Instagram post Thursday, saying Fiona died after swallowing a hat that accidentally fell into her habitat last week.

recentItems.title: Army postpones plan to detonate nearly 10,000 pounds of lead azide until Monday
recentItems.description:
The controlled detonation of nearly 10,000 pounds of lead azine at a U.S. Army plant in Iowa has been postponed until early next week, Army officials announced Thursday, a day before the planned blast.

"Public safety is the Army’s top priority, and I have directed Army Materiel Command to postpone tomorrow’s controlled detonation at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa until Monday, November 23," Army Secretary Adam Telle said in a post on social media.
